title: Token-cost phase event
description: One explicit phase enter/exit line a later helper writes. Not a harvested vendor log.

schemaVersion.description: Literal schema version. Always 1 for this contract.

event.description: Whether this line marks entering or leaving the stage.

stageId.description: IDD stage this event belongs to.

at.description: UTC timestamp of the enter or exit.

vendorSessionId.description: Opaque vendor session id when known. Never a filesystem path.

claimId.description: The active IDD {claim-id} when this event is claim-scoped. Positive evidence that two differently-vendorSessionId'd stage windows for the same issue belong to one continuous claim lineage (a handoff/resume), not two unrelated attempts.

issueNumber.description: Issue number when the event is issue-scoped.

usage.description: Optional token usage snapshot at this event.
